541.head: Debu (+91 98765 43210)
541.tr:
Employee: Hello Debu ji, Naresh bol raha hoon [Company Name] se. Aapne inquiry ki thi PCD franchise ke liye?
Customer: Haan Naresh ji, main Debu bol raha hoon Gorakhpur se. Interested hoon aapki company ke saath kaam karne mein.
Employee: Bahut badhiya Debu ji. Batayein, kis segment mein interest hai aapko? Aur Gorakhpur ke liye aap monopoly chahte hain?
Customer: Haan ji, Gorakhpur mein monopoly chahiye. Main mainly Antibiotics aur Derma segment mein interested hoon. Jaise Cefixime 200mg, Amoxiclav dry syrup, aur kuch skin creams, ointments. Kya range hai aapke paas?
Employee: Humare paas in segments mein kaafi strong product portfolio hai, Debu ji. Cefixime 200mg tablets, Amoxiclav dry syrup, aur derma mein bhi creams, lotions, soaps ki achhi range hai. Monopoly bhi mil jayegi Gorakhpur ke liye, no issue.
Customer: Theek hai. Pricing kaisi hai aapki? Aur kya support milega marketing ke liye? Visual aids, samples, etc.
Employee: Pricing bahut competitive hai Debu ji. Aur marketing support mein hum visual aids, product literature, samples, aur promotional schemes bhi provide karte hain. Aapko main WhatsApp pe poora product catalog aur rate list bhej deta hoon. Aap review kijiye, phir hum detail mein discuss kar sakte hain.
Customer: Haan, theek hai Naresh ji. WhatsApp pe bhej dijiye. Main jaldi se jaldi review karke aapko call back karta hoon. Gorakhpur mein mera network kaafi strong hai, so I'm looking for a long-term association.
Employee: Perfect Debu ji. Main abhi bhej deta hoon. Aapko koi specific product ya molecule ki priority hai toh bata dijiye, main usko highlight kar dunga.
Customer: Bas yahi, Antibiotics aur Derma pe focus rakhiye. Aur pricing competitive ho.
Employee: Definitely Debu ji. Sending it now. Thank you for your interest.
Customer: Thank you, Naresh ji.
